limitations: Current aggregate forecast comparison; no observed 2026 outcomes or demonstrated 2026 accuracy.
Conditional shares describe only the two named principal contenders. Group win probabilities are separate, and pooled probabilities are never assigned to individual members.
Alaska and CA-06 use declared independent-candidate predictor proxies. Independent and other-party winners remain unassigned for the 218-seat party-majority calculation.
Ranked-choice and runoff contests use ultimate-winner approximations. Ballot transfers, runoff rounds, turnout and candidate vote counts are not simulated.
The roster includes captured printed candidates and documented declared write-ins. Some districts rely on secondary sources; later filings and legal changes require a new release.
Polling uses a dated reviewed question subset with an approximate ingestion-date availability rule. It is not an exhaustive polling census or a direct audit of every questionnaire.

Historical posterior banks and calibrated polling-error scales are finite. Predictive simulation precision does not establish empirical calibration or integrate polling covariance-estimation uncertainty.
The historical House benchmark found polling gains in many comparisons and material 2020 losses. Failed historical chamber precision remains part of that evidence.
A House-specific tipping statistic is not qualified. The race list and ribbon must not be described as tipping probabilities.
